name: MPSTATS
description: MPSTATS marketplace analytics for Wildberries and Ozon, read-only: sales, estimated revenue, prices and stock per warehouse and size for any item, search queries and positions, competitors of an item, and market figures and trends of subjects or niches, categories, brands and sellers.
prerequisites: An MPSTATS account on a plan with API access and its API token from the account settings.
instructions:
## MPSTATS
This connector uses the **MPSTATS Analytics API** (`https://mpstats.io/api/analytics/v1`): market analytics for **Wildberries** (`/wb`) and **Ozon** (`/oz`) collected by MPSTATS. It reads public marketplace data for any item, subject or niche, category, brand or seller, yours or a competitor's: sales, estimated revenue, prices, stock per warehouse and size, search queries and positions. Every tool only reads; nothing on the marketplaces is changed. It does not reach your own seller cabinet: for orders and finance use the Wildberries or Ozon connector.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://mpstats.io with an account whose plan includes API requests, open the account settings and copy the token from the **API token** block into `MPSTATS_API_TOKEN`.
2. Install and run `mpstats_wb_get_keyword_frequency` to check the token.

The token is sent in the `X-Mpstats-TOKEN` header. It changes when the account password is changed or **Change API token** is pressed; paste the new one then.

**Cost and limits**: every call counts against the request quota of your MPSTATS plan. 429 means the quota is used up (the message says why, `Retry-After` says when to retry); 202 means MPSTATS is still preparing the report, so call again a little later. Keep periods short and pages small, and reuse what you already fetched instead of calling again.

**Wildberries workflow**
- Resolve names first: `mpstats_wb_find_items` (SKUs or keyword), `mpstats_wb_search_subjects`, `mpstats_wb_search_sellers`, `mpstats_wb_search_brands`.
- One item: `mpstats_wb_get_item`, `mpstats_wb_get_item_sales` (per day: sales, revenue, stock, price, category position), `mpstats_wb_get_item_search_stats`, `mpstats_wb_list_item_keywords` (queries and positions), `mpstats_wb_get_item_stock_by_warehouse`, `mpstats_wb_get_item_stock_by_size`, `mpstats_wb_get_item_sales_by_warehouse`, `mpstats_wb_get_item_sales_by_size`.
- Competitors of an item: `mpstats_wb_list_related_items` (relation similar, in_similar, identical_wb or identical).
- Niche analysis: `mpstats_wb_list_subject_items`, `mpstats_wb_list_subject_breakdown` (categories, brands, sellers), `mpstats_wb_get_subject_trend` (seasonality).
- Category analysis: `mpstats_wb_list_category_items`, `mpstats_wb_list_category_breakdown` (subcategories, subjects, brands, sellers), `mpstats_wb_get_category_trend`.
- A shop or brand: `mpstats_wb_list_seller_items`, `mpstats_wb_list_brand_items`. Search demand: `mpstats_wb_get_keyword_frequency`.

**Ozon workflow**: `mpstats_oz_find_items`, `mpstats_oz_get_item`, `mpstats_oz_get_item_sales`, `mpstats_oz_list_item_keywords`, `mpstats_oz_get_item_category_positions`, `mpstats_oz_get_item_stock_by_warehouse` (one day), `mpstats_oz_get_item_sales_by_warehouse`, `mpstats_oz_list_similar_items`; niches with `mpstats_oz_search_niches` and `mpstats_oz_list_niche_items`; categories with `mpstats_oz_list_category_items`, `mpstats_oz_list_category_breakdown` (subcategories, niches, brands, sellers) and `mpstats_oz_get_category_trend`; shops and brands with `mpstats_oz_search_sellers`, `mpstats_oz_list_seller_items` and `mpstats_oz_list_brand_items`.

**Identifiers**: items are marketplace SKUs (the Wildberries article number nmId, the Ozon SKU). Wildberries subjects and Ozon niches and sellers use numeric ids from the search tools; categories are full paths with `/`, exactly as MPSTATS shows them (e.g. `Женщинам/Джинсы`); brands are names.

**Periods and figures**: `d1` and `d2` are `YYYY-MM-DD`; always pass them, the default period differs from method to method. Data runs to yesterday. Sales and revenue are MPSTATS estimates from public marketplace data, in roubles; quote them as estimates, not as the seller's accounting. `fbs=1` adds sales shipped from the seller's own warehouse (FBS), `0` counts marketplace warehouses (FBO) only.

**Paging, sorting and filters**: list tools return `startRow`, `endRow`, `total` and `data`. At most 500 rows per call: raise `startRow`/`endRow` to page. `sortModel` sorts, e.g. `[{"colId": "revenue", "sort": "desc"}]`; `filterModel` filters columns, e.g. `{"revenue": {"filterType": "number", "type": "greaterThan", "filter": 100000}}` (text filters: equals, contains, startsWith...; number and date filters: lessThan, greaterThan, inRange with filterTo).

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong or changed token. 429 means the plan's request quota is used up. 202 means the report is not ready yet. 500 carries the reason in `message`.

MPSTATS_API_TOKEN.label: API token
MPSTATS_API_TOKEN.help: MPSTATS, account settings, API token block: copy the token. It changes when the password is changed or Change API token is pressed.
MPSTATS_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token (letters, digits and a dot), without spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: MPSTATS refused the token. Copy it again from the API token block of the account settings; it changes when the password is changed.
verifyHints.rate_limited: The request quota of your MPSTATS plan is used up. Wait for the time in Retry-After or check the plan.

d2.description: End date of the report, YYYY-MM-DD (data is complete up to yesterday).
